isabel: Kickoff for cloud marketplace listings (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need to finalize SKU schema, minimal trial wording, and a telemetry meter mapping this sprint. I dropped a short checklist in the drive: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/quickstart

Tom-partnerships: Suggest concise SKU pattern: `rw-<cloud>-<svc>-<plan>-<region>[-trial]` so scripts can split on `-`. Example: `rw-aws-inference-pro-us-west-2-trial`. Keeps publisher tooling simple.

elaine-legal: If we include `-trial` we must include `trial_period_days` and the EULA DPA link in the offer metadata; Azure is the pickiest. I can write the minimal required blurb once you post the SKU list.

ravi-eng: Telemetry contract: emit `marketplace.event.purchase` with keys: sku, offer_id, plan, customer_hash, meter (RW_TOKENS|RW_EMB|RW_SESSIONS), cloud, region. Add header `X-RW-TRACE`. We'll add CI smoke that verifies the event shows up.

osps-bot: sandbox provisioning queued: ticket SAND-2001. ETA 24h.

isabel: Owners: Tom -> SKU CSV, Ravi -> telemetry mapping + CI checks, Elaine -> legal copy. Target a staging canary next Tue. I'll update the checklist and tag owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
